decisions.reason: Using the client-provided Flat Plan as the arrangement basis does not change the polished, modern, brand-aligned visual-style requirement.
The Flat Plan governs magazine arrangement and does not change the requirement to improve article image quality when necessary.
The arrangement basis does not change the required digital flipbook deliverable or its scope.
The Flat Plan does not resume or alter the deferred print-ready output requirement, its resolution, or its trim-and-bleed settings.
The Flat Plan determines content arrangement but does not change the specified website as the source of articles.
The Flat Plan does not change the required author name, circular author photo, or coverage of every article.
